candidates.description: The polychronization network model generating polychronous groups
candidates.citation_sentence: The polychronization network model was proposed by Izhikevich (2006) as a minimal spiking neural network model capable of exhibiting polychronization, consisting of randomly coupled point neurons expressing STDP
candidates.notes: The paper is primarily a reproducibility guideline paper; the replication of Izhikevich (2006) serves as a demonstrative example. Section 3.1 reports successful replication of main results, but the Discussion (Section 4) concludes that the original results generalize very poorly and are sensitive to implementation choices, making the overall outcome ambiguous.
